annotations.title: Look up a US drug's fair cash price

description: Look up what US pharmacies actually pay to acquire a drug (CMS NADAC benchmark), a fair cash-price estimate range, FDA generic equivalents, and Medicare negotiated prices where applicable. Returns match, candidates (disambiguate and call again), or no_match.

query.description: Drug name with optional strength/form, e.g. "atorvastatin 20 mg" or "eliquis 5 mg tablet". Generic (ingredient) names match best.

name: drug_price
